title.en: Incense, Almsgiving and the State Ledger

title.en: Which Granary Opens in a Lean Year

desc.en: The lean year has arrived and the charity and state granaries must be audited face to face. Patron grain is entered as patronage; public grain is paid for from the treasury. The ledger does not mix them.

desc.zh: 供养关系结束之后，账册须结清。按底线记录结案；施主已不可联系时，本地按已有账目自行收束。
desc.en: When the patronage ends the ledger must be closed on the bottom-line record. If the patron is unavailable, Tibet closes alone on the accounts it holds.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t07_tib_delivery_1307 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t07_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t07_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t07_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t07_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t07_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t07_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

label.en: Close the ledger on the charter

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t07_tib_at_1307 var:ywc_t07_proposed_outcome ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t07_outcome value = 1 } change_relations = { country = c:MGL value = 5 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t07_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:MGL = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t07_patron_standing value = 1 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 章程入册结案，蒙古对西藏关系增加 5。
consequence_note.en: The charter closes the ledger; Mongolia gains 5 relations with Tibet.

label.en: Close the ledger as limited cooperation

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t07_tib_at_1307 var:ywc_t07_proposed_outcome ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t07_outcome value = 2 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t07_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:MGL = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t07_patron_standing value = 2 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 记为有限合作结案。
consequence_note.en: Close the ledger as limited cooperation.

label.zh: 记为拒绝外部干涉结案
label.en: Close the ledger as refused interference

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t07_tib_at_1307 var:ywc_t07_proposed_outcome ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t07_outcome value = 3 } change_relations = { country = c:MGL value = -5 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t07_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:MGL = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t07_patron_standing value = 3 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 记为拒绝外部干涉结案，蒙古对西藏关系减少 5。
consequence_note.en: Close the ledger as refusal of outside interference; Mongolia loses 5 relations with Tibet.

label.zh: 施主已不可联系，本地自行结案
label.en: Close locally because the patron is unavailable

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t07_tib_at_1307 NOT = { ywc_t07_partner_current = yes } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t07_partner_fund } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t07_outcome value = 4 } } else_if = { limit = { var:ywc_t07_partner_fund ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t07_outcome value = 3 } } else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t07_outcome value = 2 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t07_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 施主已不可联系，本地按账册自行结案；已支付的费用不退。
consequence_note.en: The patron is unavailable; Tibet closes on its own ledger. Expenses already paid are not refunded.
